claims.quote: It originates from the northern parts of Burma.
The armoured stickleback, Indostomus paradoxus, is a tiny fish from Myanmar, described from Lake Indawgyi and recorded in the Ayeyarwady basin.

Described from Lake Indawgyi, with most of the type series collected at its northern end, near Nyaungbin, Kachin state, northern Myanmar, and subsequently recorded in tributaries of the Ayeyarwady/Irrawaddy River around the state capital of Myitkyina.
